- (a2) Added initial support for Folia servers
- (a2) Added unified data migration service
- (a2) Added migration for pet inventory data to new Paper ItemStack format
- (a2) Added migration for dropping database info.version column
- (a2) Added migration for swapping pets.owner_uuid column value with player's Mojang UUID
- (a2) Added migration for dropping database player.name, player.internal_uuid, and player.mojang_uuid columns and replacing them with player.uuid with values from player.mojang_uuid column
- (a2) Added migration for converting pet names from color codes to MiniMessage codes
- (a2) Added migration for converting config files from color codes to MiniMessage codes
- (a2) Added migration for converting locale files from color codes to MiniMessage codes
- (a2) Added migration for converting skilltree files from color codes to MiniMessage codes
- (a2) Removed support for MongoDB databases
- (a1) Dropped support for Bukkit/Spigot servers (Paper and derivatives only)
- (a1) Dropped support for server versions below 1.20.6
- (a1) Updated to Java 21
- (a1) Load required dependencies on startup through Spigot's library downloader

- (a1) Replaced command system with Paper's Brigadier Commands API
- (a1) Replaced NBT library with Adventure NBT
- (a1) Replaced all messaging with Adventure Components
